newsitem.title: USA: Comerci files 2.6 mln depositary shares.
newsitem.headline: Comerci files 2.6 mln depositary shares.

text.p: Controladora Comercial Mexicana S.A. de C.V. filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 2.6 million global depositary shares.
The shares represent 52.0 million units, each consisting of three Series B shares and one Series C share, the company, Mexico's second largest retailer, said.
Comerci, as the company is known, said it anticipates that the depositary shares' price will be determined by reference to the market price for the units.
The offering is part of a combined sale of 73,494,171 units consisting of 2.6 million depositary shares in the U.S. and other countries outside Mexico and 21,494,171 units in Mexico.
The company said the three B shares and one C share comprising each unit trade together as a single security and are not separable.

The company said net proceeds from the offering are estimated to range from $70.0 millino to $80.8 million assuming an initial public offering price of $20.41 per depositary share. The proceeds will be used to repay debt under a May 1966 credit agreement, it said.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, and J.P. Morgan & Co. Acciones y Valores de Mexico S.A. de C.V., Grupo Financier Banamex Accival is global coordinator, it said.
